style: Gloomy post-apocalyptic mood like Rust and Project Zomboid, desaturated palette, highly detailed hand-painted digital art, soft overcast light from the top-left, no outline.
framing: A single game sprite for a 2D top-down survival game drawn in 3/4 view (camera from the south, looking down about 50 degrees, like Project Zomboid). The whole object fully visible and centered, its base at the bottom center. Transparent background, no ground, no cast shadow, no text, no frame, no border.
tile_framing: A seamless tileable square game texture filling the entire image edge to edge, orthographic with no perspective, even flat lighting everywhere, no vignette, no objects cut off by the edges, no text, no frame.

icon_framing: A single inventory icon for a survival game: the item alone, centered, filling most of the square image, shown at a slight 3/4 angle, transparent background, no text, no letters, no frame, no border, no cast shadow.
weapon_framing: A single game sprite of a weapon or tool for a survival game: the item alone, strict side view, horizontal, pointing to the right (muzzle or business end on the right), centered, transparent background, no hands, no text, no frame, no border, no cast shadow.
sheet_framing: A character sprite sheet for a 2D top-down survival game in 3/4 view like Project Zomboid: a grid of 4 columns and 2 rows of equally spaced frames on a transparent background. Top row: the same person walking diagonally toward the camera and to the right (front 3/4 view, facing down-right), 4 frames of one walk cycle. Bottom row: the same person walking diagonally away from the camera and to the right (back 3/4 view, facing up-right), 4 frames of one walk cycle. Identical character, proportions, clothing and lighting in every frame, full body visible, feet on the same baseline within each row, arms relaxed with empty hands, no weapon, no text, no labels, no grid lines, no frame borders, no cast shadow.
clutter_style: Bold readable silhouette with simple large shapes and strong value contrast so it stays recognizable when shrunk to a tiny pixel-art sprite; no tiny fussy details.
rig_framing: A single isolated body part sprite for a 2D cutout animation rig, taken from the character shown in the attached reference image: exactly the same skin tone, dirt, hair, clothing colors, lighting from the top-left and painting style. Only that one body part, cleanly separated at the joints with rounded joint ends, centered, transparent background, nothing else in the image, no shadow, no text, no frame.
ui_framing: A single flat user-interface element texture for a gritty post-apocalyptic survival game HUD, seen straight-on (orthographic, no perspective), crisp readable shapes, the element fills the image edge to edge, transparent background outside the element, no text, no letters, no numbers, no logos.
